entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: An ancient egalitarian civilization of communes living in the Core of Ixalan, guardians of the Core and living ancestors of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: A surface empire descended from Komon Winaq who left the Core.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A world made by Chimil and shepherded by her children, the Deep Gods.

entities.name: The Core of Ixalan
entities.description: The idyllic interior of Ixalan lit by the sun Chimil, home of the Oltec.

entities.name: Oteclan
entities.description: The Oltec capital city, home to the grandest temples of the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Chimil
aliases: the sun at the center of Ixalan's Core
entities.description: The progenitor god and sun at the center of the Core, creator of humans and mother of the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: The living deities of the Oltec, children of Chimil; four are aligned with the Oltec and the fifth is Aclazotz.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The final child of the Fourth People, progenitor of vampires and an evil deity who feeds on fear of death.

entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: The god of fury and strength who raised the Thousand Moons and defeated Aclazotz.

entities.name: Ojer Pakpatiq
entities.description: The god of cyclical time, whose priests are the didacts.

entities.name: Ojer Taq
entities.description: Considered chief among the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Ojer Kaslem
entities.description: A Deep God served by the Gardener Order.

entities.name: Tan Jolom
entities.description: A worldwalker who left open a door through which dark afterlife creatures entered.

entities.name: Thousand Moons
entities.description: The one thousand professional warrior priests of Ojer Axonil.

entities.name: Cosmium eaters
entities.description: A secretive cult of Aclazotz-worshippers who free him and are turned into vampire demons.

entities.name: Gardener Order
entities.description: The priests and laypersons of Ojer Kaslem who tend the wild and fight mycoids.

entities.name: Didacts
entities.description: Priests of Ojer Pakpatiq who are teachers, explorers and scholars.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: Giant colonizers who invaded the Core and caged Chimil in a metal prison.

entities.name: Whispering War
entities.description: A war between the Komon Winaq and the cults of Aclazotz, ended when the Deep Gods intervened.

entities.name: Night War
entities.description: The war that ended 320 years of darkness when Chimil shattered her prison and the Fomori were expelled.

entities.name: Quiet Age
entities.description: A peaceful period of rebuilding and expansion after the Night War.

entities.name: Cosmium
entities.description: Chimil's gift, a substance the Oltec have mastered that protects them and enhances life, health and magic.

entities.name: Mycoids
entities.description: Creatures whose spread forced the Oltec and the Sun Empire to seal off contact.

events.summary: The first humans awaken inside the Core of Paradise and understand Chimil as their creator, becoming the Komon Winaq.
events.quote: Humans stood to their full height under Chimil and understood her to be their creator.

events.summary: Dark creatures enter the world through a door left open by Tan Jolom; Aclazotz hardens the veil between life and death and feeds on fear.
events.quote: he hardened that gossamer veil between life and death to impregnable stone

events.summary: Cults of Aclazotz form and fight back against the elders, spreading violence across the Core.
events.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon Winaq raged with violence.

events.summary: Ojer Axonil and his thousand champions defeat Aclazotz, tearing out an eye and dragging him back beyond the veil, ending the Whispering War.
events.quote: the god of fury and strength tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and subdued him

events.summary: The Coin Empire invades the Core, blots out Chimil's light and cages her in a metal prison.
events.quote: They blotted out the light of Chimil and then caged her within a metal prison.

events.summary: Chimil shatters the Fomori prison and cosmium blasts away the Fomori, creating the first angels of Ixalan; the Deep Gods return.
events.quote: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the Fomori while innervating the Komon

events.summary: The Night War ends with the Fomori expelled from the Core.
events.quote: The war ended with the Fomori expelled from the Core

events.summary: Some Komon Winaq go to the surface and become the Sun Empire; those who stay become the Oltec.
events.quote: Some of the Komon Winaq traveled to the plane's surface, later becoming the Sun Empire.

events.summary: Contact between the Oltec and Sun Empire is sealed off because of the spread of the mycoids.
events.quote: They maintained regular trade with the Oltec until the spread of the mycoids forced the two to seal off contact.

events.summary: Cosmium eaters free Aclazotz from imprisonment and are turned into vampire demons.
events.quote: They were turned into vampire demons by their god after freeing him from his imprisonment.

events.summary: During the Quiet Age the Oltec repair Night War damage and expand into unexplored parts of the Core.
events.quote: During the Quiet Age, there was very little conflict between groups and no war.
